traceability.notes: All specified requirements for 005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION are implemented and verified. The valid-annotation-format ESLint rule and its helpers provide robust syntax and format validation for @story and @req annotations, including multi-line handling, configurable patterns, and clear, specific error messages. Comprehensive tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts directly reference this story and its REQ IDs and are all passing. Documentation in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md defines the format rules and offers concrete valid/invalid examples that align with the story. Integration is achieved at the ESLint rule level by scanning all comments, so it naturally works with annotations used by function and branch rules. Therefore, this story is fully satisfied.
